scenario: Suricata NIDS Alert & EVE Telemetry: CobaltStrike C2 Beaconing, Internal SMB Reconnaissance, and High-Volume TLS Exfiltration
summary: On 2026-10-16, Suricata NIDS detected an intrusion originating from internal host WS-FINANCE-01 (192.168.1.105). Telemetry captured initial DNS resolution for beacon.apt29-c2.net, periodic TLS C2 beaconing to external C2 IP 203.0.113.88 on port 8443 (matched signature ET MALWARE Win32/CobaltStrike Malleable C2 Beacon with SNI beacon.apt29-c2.net), followed by internal reconnaissance sweeping DC-AUTH-01 (192.168.1.10) over SMB port 445, and high-volume data exfiltration (94.5 MB) to 203.0.113.88 over port 8443.
kill_chain: 14:15:00 DNS query for beacon.apt29-c2.net resolved to 203.0.113.88 (ET DNS Query for Known Suspicious Dynamic DNS / APT C2 Domain)

14:17:00-14:50:00 Repeated TLS C2 beaconing (12 alerts) from 192.168.1.105 to 203.0.113.88:8443 with TLS SNI beacon.apt29-c2.net and JA3 a0e9f5d64349fb13191bc781f81f42e1 (ET MALWARE Win32/CobaltStrike Malleable C2 Beacon)
15:00:00-15:01:00 Internal SMB enumeration sweep (5 alerts) from 192.168.1.105 to Domain Controller 192.168.1.10:445 (ET SCAN Potential SMB Sweep to Domain Controller)
15:25:00 High-volume outbound data exfiltration flow (94.5 MB) from 192.168.1.105 to 203.0.113.88:8443 (ET EXFIL Suspicious High-Volume Encrypted Outbound Data Flow)
